title: Explicit restriction-localization chain
statement: For a morphism h:X→Y, an open W and any complex I on X, construct a map from derived restriction of Q(h_*I) to R(h|W)_* of derived restriction of QI. Compose the exact Y-restriction factor, Q of the underived restriction/direct-image comparison, the direct-image localization unit on the restricted complex, and R(h|W)_* of the inverse exact X-restriction factor. These are actual maps, not a choice from an existence theorem. The definition is irreducible so downstream composition uses its declared endpoints. Definitions: [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data], [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data], [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model].

def schemeMVRestrictionLocalizationChain
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    (schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y W).obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
          (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage h.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ⟶
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (h ∣_ W)).obj
        ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I))
